text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear position in first sentence and repeated stance throughout","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a definite argument early and keeps that position visible as the essay develops."},{"evidence":"mentions malfunction, crash, traffic jam, speeding tickets, DUI's, and accidents","quality":"use of supporting details","description":"It draws on several relevant facts and examples to back up its claims about driverless cars."},{"evidence":"weighs cons against benefits before concluding","quality":"balanced reasoning","description":"It acknowledges both sides of the issue and then explains why the benefits may still matter."},{"evidence":"“So whats the point...?”, “Only time will tell”","quality":"argument development","description":"It moves from claim to counterpoint to a concluding judgment instead of relying mainly on unsupported opinion."},{"evidence":"opening hook about technology getting more complex each day","quality":"engagement","description":"It uses a more interesting introduction that draws the reader into the topic."}]}
